profile.title: Organizational Systems
profile.canonical_definition: Raul Espejo and Alfonso Reyes's synthesis of organisational cybernetics, the Viable System Model, Viplan, variety engineering and methodology for diagnosis, design and implementation.
profile.summary: Organizational Systems combines concepts, VSM, Viplan and systemic methodology into an integrated account of organisational diagnosis and design.
profile.why_it_matters: It provides a major practice-facing bridge from Beer's VSM to methods of organisational cybernetics, including implementation problems and variety engineering.
common_misreadings: it is only a VSM textbook
organisation can be diagnosed without clarifying identity
